items.title: Apple leadership page updated as John Ternus becomes the new CEO
items.title_zh: 苹果领导层页更新：John Ternus 正式出任 CEO
items.summary: Apple officially handed the CEO role from Tim Cook to John Ternus on September 1. The company's newly updated leadership page gives Ternus the CEO title, with Cook moving to the Board of Directors section in his new role as Executive Chair.

items.title: TARS Raises $455M Pre-A Round, Setting Record in China’s Embodied AI Sector
items.title_zh: TARS 完成 4.55 亿美元 Pre-A 轮融资，创中国具身智能纪录
items.summary: TARS has completed a $455 million Pre-A funding round (approximately RMB 3.3 billion), setting a new record for the largest single-round financing in China's embodied AI sector.

items.title: Anthropic upgrades Claude with new Fable 5.1 model, details here
items.title_zh: Anthropic 为 Claude 升级新模型 Fable 5.1
items.summary: Anthropic is upgrading Claude with a new Fable 5.1 model, three months after it first released Fable 5, its Mythos-class AI model, in June.

items.title: Tesla confirms Full Self-Driving was active in a crash that killed a mother of five
items.title_zh: 特斯拉确认 FSD 涉入伊利诺伊州致命车祸：夺命“普通路口事故”
items.summary: Tesla's own report to federal regulators confirms its driver-assist system was engaged when a Model Y turning left at an intersection in Batavia, Illinois collided with a pickup truck, killing passenger Maggie Espinosa, 37, a teacher and mother of five — an incident previously reported as an ordinary intersection crash. It is part of Electrek's ongoing investigation matching crashes to Tesla's redacted NHTSA data.

items.title: Kuaishou’s Kling AI brings in China AI fund with RMB1.4 billion investment
items.title_zh: 快手可灵引入国家人工智能产业投资基金 14 亿元投资
items.summary: Kuaishou's Kling AI unit, Beijing Kling Technology, has signed agreements to bring in the China Artificial Intelligence Industry Investment Fund and Charoen Pokphand Robot as new investors. The China AI fund will invest RMB1.4 billion for about 1.14% of the company, while CP Robot will invest about $19.29 million (RMB131.45 million) for about 0.11%.

items.title: Former Qwen Tech Chief Lin Junyang Launches Pragmatik Labs with a Two-Billion-Dollar Valuation — and Pivots from Foundation Models to Agents
items.title_zh: 前通义千问技术负责人林军阳创办 Pragmatik Labs：估值 20 亿美元，转向 Agent
items.summary: Lin Junyang, the former Alibaba Qwen technical lead and one of the youngest P10-level engineers at the company, has founded Pragmatik Labs in Shanghai at a $2 billion angel-round valuation. Gaorong and HSG co-led with $100 million each, Tencent added $20 million, and the company is positioning itself around digital and physical agents rather than another foundation model.

items.title: Tracking the fatal Tesla Autopilot and FSD crashes hidden in its data
items.title_zh: 追踪被“抹黑”的特斯拉 Autopilot/FSD 致命事故数据
items.summary: Electrek reports that Tesla blacks out almost everything in the Autopilot and "Full Self-Driving" crash reports it files with the federal government, so the public never learns what happened in those crashes. The outlet says it is matching those redacted reports, one by one, to fatal crashes covered in the news as ordinary accidents.

items.title: Waymo opens robotaxi rides to the public in 3 new cities, now 14 total
items.title_zh: Waymo 在丹佛、圣地亚哥、坦帕向公众开放 Robotaxi，总数达 14 城
items.summary: Waymo opened its driverless ride-hailing service to the general public in Denver, San Diego and Tampa on Monday, bringing the Alphabet-owned company to 14 US cities. Tens of thousands of people in each market had already signed up, and Waymo says it will admit them gradually over the coming weeks.

items.title: Poco F9 Pro and F9 Ultra launch with 185Hz panels, 8 Elite Gen 5 chips, and huge batteries
items.title_zh: Poco F9 Pro / F9 Ultra 发布：185Hz 屏、骁龙 8 Elite Gen 5、大电池
items.summary: Xiaomi sub-brand Poco is officially expanding its flagship smartphone line with the launch of the Poco F9 Pro and Poco F9 Ultra, which feature 185Hz panels, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chips and large batteries.

items.title: Galaxy Z Fold 8 is so popular that Samsung is stealing parts from next year’s phones just to make more
items.title_zh: Galaxy Z Fold 8 太抢手：三星挪用明年机型部件扩产
items.summary: Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 has proven so popular that the company is reportedly taking parts production from its 2027 smartphones just to meet demand for the foldable.

items.title: The US added a record 20.2 GWh of battery storage in just 3 months
items.title_zh: 美国单季新增电池储能创纪录：3 个月 20.2 GWh
items.summary: The US battery storage market posted its biggest quarter ever, adding 20.2 gigawatt-hours (GWh) of new capacity in Q2 2026.

items.title: iOS 27 breaks 15 years of muscle memory on iPhone and iPad
items.title_zh: iOS 27 打破 iPhone/iPad 延续 15 年的操作习惯
items.summary: Starting with iOS 27, Apple is making a major change to how users open Notification Center on iPhone and iPad — a central alerts location since iOS 5 in 2011. The behavior shifted between the first two betas, but eight developer betas so far indicate the change will ship this month, per 9to5Mac.

items.title: OpenAI calls trade secret dispute ‘a mess of Apple’s own making’
items.title_zh: OpenAI 回应苹果商业机密指控："这是苹果自己制造的烂摊子"
items.summary: Apple has alleged that two of its former employees, including Chang Liu who moved to OpenAI, stole trade secrets relating to hardware design and more, presenting what it called "shocking evidence" based on analysis of a MacBook owned by Liu. OpenAI hit back with its own legal filing, calling the situation "a mess of Apple's own making."

items.title: Direct Drive Bets Wheel-Legged Robots Solve the First Hurdle of Embodied AI: Getting In
items.title_zh: Direct Drive 押注轮腿式机器人，破解具身智能“进场”难题
items.summary: Chinese startup Direct Drive argues the bottleneck for embodied robots is not a smarter brain but physical access to the real world, pairing direct-drive actuators with wheel-legged designs to cross curbs, slopes and mixed indoor-outdoor spaces.

items.title: China's Floatboat Harness Beats Claude Opus 4.8 on All Five Benchmarks While Running on the Cheapest Model on the Market
items.title_zh: 中国 Floatboat 执行框架宣称让廉价 DeepSeek 模型反超 Claude Opus 4.8
items.summary: AOE Tech Labs' Floatboat team reports a single-variable benchmark experiment run on August 7: with DeepSeek-V4-Flash as the model base and only the execution harness swapped, the same $0.14 model went from losing all five benchmarks against Claude Opus 4.8 on DeepSeek's own harness to winning all five on Floatboat's harness, at 57.1 times lower cost.

items.title: China’s first AIGC long-form drama debuts on Mango TV and Hunan TV
items.title_zh: 中国首部上星 AIGC 长剧《后西游记》登陆芒果TV与湖南卫视
items.summary: Mango TV's AIGC drama "The Later Journey to the West" has begun streaming on Mango TV and airing during Hunan TV's prime-time schedule. The first-season Huaguoshan arc is billed as China's first AIGC long-form drama to reach a satellite-TV audience, produced through Mango TV's Mango Lingchuang AI content platform.

items.title: Swedish chip expert Henry Homayoun Radamson dies in China of ‘sudden illness’, aged 63
items.title_zh: 瑞典芯片专家 Henry Homayoun Radamson 在沪逝世，享年 63 岁
items.summary: Award-winning Swedish chip expert Henry Homayoun Radamson has died in Shanghai at 63. Radamson, who moved to China in 2016, was chief scientist at the Guangdong Greater Bay Area Institute of Integrated Circuit and System; the institute said he died of a "sudden illness" on August 12. In 2023 he received the Chinese Government Friendship Award.

items.title: MRTIS TechBio Secures Approval for Hong Kong IPO Filing

items.summary: MRTIS TechBio (Beijing), an AI-driven nanomedicine company, has received regulatory clearance from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) for its Hong Kong IPO filing.
